svg.title: ReturnPath: from a customer request to a checked result
svg.desc: General assistants such as Poke cover many everyday tasks. ReturnPath focuses on return resolution: a customer advocate talks with a merchant agent, the customer accepts exact permitted terms, and guarded code executes and verifies the refund. The fixed Stripe workflow is verified; the new agreement connection still needs a connected run. Recovery is checked after an operator restarts the worker.

g.text: From a request to a checked result
Poke: everyday assistance through messaging. ReturnPath: resolve a return with a merchant.
We expose the parties, permitted terms, acceptance and evidence. Other products' internal safeguards are not assessed.
An agent cannot accept for them.
The model has no refund tool.
What if the worker dies after payment?
Watchdog alerts. A person restarts the worker.
Recovery checks for an existing refund before retrying.
No automatic process restart is claimed.
Stripe TEST: retrieve actual refund records.
Gmail: customer update. Slack: actionable case update.
Success is supported by provider evidence, not a model assertion.
Verified: original Gmail + Stripe TEST + Slack run; local simulated crash/restart; live language smoke tests.
Still to verify: new agreement-to-Stripe run and connected crash/restart. Warehouse evidence is simulated.
Scope reference: poke.com/docs · This is a workflow explanation, not a transcript or a benchmark against another product.
